# Monthly net excise taxes for FY 2018 (Oct 2017 - Sept 2018)
# From the table: Net excise taxes (column 35)
months = [7463, 7240, 6867, 6168, 5878, 7849, 6905, 7325, 7343, 7716, 8154, 16079]

print("Monthly net excise taxes (in millions):")
print(months)
print()

# Calculate Mean
mean = sum(months) / len(months)
print(f"Mean: {mean}")
print()

# Calculate Absolute Deviations
abs_deviations = [abs(x - mean) for x in months]
print("Absolute deviations:")
for i, ad in enumerate(abs_deviations):
    print(f"  Month {i+1}: |{months[i]} - {mean:.2f}| = {ad:.2f}")
print()

# Calculate MAD (Mean Absolute Deviation)
mad = sum(abs_deviations) / len(abs_deviations)
print(f"Mean Absolute Deviation (MAD): {mad}")
print(f"MAD rounded to thousandths: {mad:.3f}")
EOF
